API 설계 ### 5.1 REST API 엔드포인트 #### 번역 API ``` POST /api/translation/start # 번역 시작 POST /api/translation/stop # 번역 중단 POST /api/translation/retry # 실패 청크 재시도 GET /api/translation/status/:jobId # 작업 상태 조회 GET /api/translation/progress/:jobId # 진행률 조회 ``` #### 용어집 API ``` POST /api/glossary/extract # 용어집 추출 시작 GET /api/glossary/:id # 용어집 조회 PUT /api/glossary/:id # 용어집 수정 DELETE /api/glossary/:id # 용어집 삭제 POST /api/glossary/import # 용어집 가져오기 GET /api/glossary/export/:id # 용어집 내보내기 ``` #### 파일 API ``` POST /api/files/upload # 파일 업로드 GET /api/files/download/:id # 파일 다운로드 DELETE /api/files/:id # 파일 삭제 GET /api/files/list # 파일 목록 ``` #### 설정 API ``` GET /api/settings # 설정 조회 PUT /api/settings # 설정 저장 GET /api/settings/models # 사용 가능 모델 목록 POST /api/settings/validate-api-key # API 키 유효성 검증 ``` ### 5.2 WebSocket 이벤트 ```typescript // WebSocket Events // Server -> Client interface TranslationProgressEvent { type: 'translation:progress'; data: TranslationJobProgressDTO; } interface TranslationLogEvent { type: 'translation:log'; data: { level: 'info' | 'warning' | 'error'; message: string; timestamp: string; }; } interface TranslationCompleteEvent { type: 'translation:complete'; data: { success: boolean; outputPath?: string; error?: string; }; } // Client -> Server interface StartTranslationCommand { type: 'translation:start'; data: TranslationRequestDTO; } interface StopTranslationCommand { type: 'translation:stop'; data: { jobId: string }; } ``` --- ## 6. 상태 관리 설계 (Zustand) ### 6.1 Store 구조 ```typescript // stores/translationStore.ts import { create } from 'zustand'; interface TranslationState { // State isRunning: boolean; progress: TranslationJobProgressDTO | null; logs: LogEntry[]; currentJobId: string | null; // Actions startTranslation: (request: TranslationRequestDTO) => Promise; stopTranslation: () => Promise; updateProgress: (progress: TranslationJobProgressDTO) => void; addLog: (log: LogEntry) => void; clearLogs: () => void; } export const useTranslationStore = create((set, get) => ({ isRunning: false, progress: null, logs: [], currentJobId: null, startTranslation: async (request) => { const response = await translationApi.start(request); set({ isRunning: true, currentJobId: response.jobId }); }, stopTranslation: async () => { const { currentJobId } = get(); if (currentJobId) { await translationApi.stop(currentJobId); set({ isRunning: false }); } }, updateProgress: (progress) => set({ progress }), addLog: (log) => set((state) => ({ logs: [...state.logs, log] })), clearLogs: () => set({ logs: [] }), })); ``` ```typescript // stores/settingsStore.ts import { create } from 'zustand'; import { persist } from 'zustand/middleware'; interface SettingsState { settings: AppConfig; isLoading: boolean; loadSettings: () => Promise; updateSettings: (partial: Partial) => void; saveSettings: () => Promise; } export const useSettingsStore = create()( persist( (set, get) => ({ settings: defaultConfig, isLoading: false, loadSettings: async () => { set({ isLoading: true }); const settings = await settingsApi.get(); set({ settings, isLoading: false }); }, updateSettings: (partial) => set((state) => ({ settings: { ...state.settings, ...partial } })), saveSettings: async () => { await settingsApi.save(get().settings); }, }), { name: 'btg-settings' } ) ); ``` --- ##
